scripts.build:public: node scripts/prepare-public.mjs && tsc -b && VITE_AUDIENCE=public vite build --outDir dist-public && cp dist-public/react.html dist-public/index.html
scripts.build:private: tsc -b && vite build --outDir dist-private && cp dist-private/react.html dist-private/index.html
scripts.build:hull: npm run extract:layout && npm run build:drawings && npm run build:elevations && npm run build:birdseye && npm run validate:layout && npm run validate:envelope && npm run validate:access
scripts.build:cad: python3 scripts/drafting/plot_decks.py && mkdir -p public/drawings/cad && cp drawings/eng-deck-*.svg drawings/P68-engineering-deck-plans.pdf public/drawings/ && cp drawings/cad/*.dxf public/drawings/cad/
scripts.build:renders: python3 scripts/drafting/render_finish.py && python3 scripts/drafting/render_exteriors.py && python3 scripts/drafting/render_interiors.py && mkdir -p public/renders && cp -r drawings/renders/finish drawings/renders/exterior drawings/renders/interior public/renders/
